## AuraView v0.3.7

### Reddit video downloads
- Resolve the playlist belonging to the selected Reddit player, including videos on the home feed.
- Convert Reddit videos to MP4 when needed and save them using the post title.

### Windows and tab bar
- Use the updated AuraView icon for newly created installer shortcuts.
- Remove the circle beside the AuraView title in the tab bar.

### Windows installers
Choose the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** below. Both install AuraView v0.3.7 for Windows x64 and bundle the configured video download tools and ad-blocking resources.

> Note: The installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning.
